ruleDefinitions.name: Bitbucket User Details Export Attempt Detected
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects user data export activity. Note: Unmapped fields: auditType.category, auditType.action

sequences.query: (auditType.category = "Users\ and\ groups" AND (auditType.action = "User\ permissions\ export\ failed" OR auditType.action = "User\ permissions\ export\ started" OR auditType.action = "User\ permissions\ exported"))
